name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0 / Mission Shakti)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
description: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana is a maternity benefit program providing conditional cash incentives via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the bank accounts of pregnant women and lactating mothers for health, nutrition, and partial wage compensation.
benefits: First Live Child: Rs. 5,000 cash incentive in two installments (Rs. 3,000 upon early pregnancy registration and at least 1 ANC checkup; Rs. 2,000 after child birth registration and completion of first cycle of immunizations)

Second Child (if Girl Child): Rs. 6,000 cash incentive in a single installment after birth registration and immunizations under Mission Shakti to discourage female foeticide and promote girl child education and nutrition
eligibility: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) who are Indian citizens aged 19 years and above
Belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged categories (SC/ST, BPL/EWS, PMAY beneficiaries, PMJAY e-card holders, MGNREGA job card holders, pregnant Divyangjan)
Women in regular employment with Central or State Government or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) or those receiving similar maternity benefits under any law are excluded
documents: Mother-Child Protection (MCP) Card registered at Anganwadi Centre / primary health clinic
Aadhaar Card of the pregnant woman applicant
Aadhaar Card of the husband / spouse
Applicant's personal Bank / Post Office account passbook linked to Aadhaar (DBT enabled)
Child Birth Certificate and Immunization Record (for 2nd installment)
steps: Register pregnancy at the local Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved government health facility within 570 days of LMP
Fill out PMMVY Application Form 1A with assistance from the Anganwadi Worker (AWW) or ASHA worker
Provide Aadhaar, MCP Card, and personal Aadhaar-linked bank details
Receive first installment (Rs. 3,000) directly into bank account via DBT
Register child's birth and complete primary vaccinations (BCG, OPV, DPT, Hepatitis B) to receive second installment
human_helpers: Anganwadi Worker (AWW) at your village or ward Anganwadi Centre
ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) healthcare worker
Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) at Primary Health Centre (PHC)
